section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that while Atik means "removed and separate," the very name implies something from which it is removed, and distinguishes between the annulment of decrees through the external aspect of Atik (as an action) and through the inner aspect of Atik (automatically), since the inner aspect is Ein Sof in Arich Anpin, where no decree has any place from the outset.
section.t: And it is known,
that although Atik is from the term "removed and separate,"
nevertheless,
from the fact that it is called by the name "Atik Yomin"
(meaning it is removed from Yomin [days]),
it is understood
that even relative to the level of Atik,
there are Yomin,
except that it is removed from them.
[And moreover,
even the level called Atik
(simply),
which is above Atik Yomin,
nevertheless,
since it is called by the name Atik,
and the meaning of Atik is that it is removed,
it is necessarily said
that there is a matter from which it is removed].
Therefore,
the nullification of the decree that comes from the level of Hishtalshelus through the drawing down of Atik is in the manner of action.
For from the perspective of Hishtalshelus
(Yomin)
it is decreed that the influence should not be,
and through the drawing down of Atik,
it is nullified.
[However, the nullification of the decree in Hishtalshelus through the drawing down of Atik is in a manner that Hishtalshelus itself becomes in such a way].
But the change in Hishtalshelus through the drawing down of the inner aspect of Atik is not in the manner of action, but automatically.
And the explanation is,
that the inner aspect of Atik is the Ein Sof that is in Arich Anpin
(as explained in the maamar).
And since the meaning of Ein Sof is that there is no limitation in Him,
it is therefore understood
that regarding Ein Sof it cannot be said that He is removed and separate from the matter of Hishtalshelus,
for relative to Him the matter of Hishtalshelus does not apply.
[And although He is found in Arich Anpin,
it is explained in the maamar that He is found in Arich Anpin as He is in His very Essence].
And from this it is understood,
that the nullification of the decree from the perspective of Hishtalshelus through the drawing down of the revelation of the inner aspect of Atik is
(not that through the revelation of the inner aspect of Atik the nullification of the decree is effected,
but rather),
that from the perspective of the revelation of the inner aspect of Atik,
Ein Sof
(which is in Arich Anpin),
there is no place for a decree from the outset.
And based on this, we can explain what is said in the maamar that the matter of "Your pious ones will bless You" is as brought in the Yerushalmi: Even if He
(the Holy One, blessed be He)
says thus and you say thus, Yours stands, Mine does not stand,
that the meaning of "Mine does not stand" is
(not that through your saying thus the decree is nullified,
but rather),
that through the revelation of the inner aspect of Atik that is drawn down through "you say thus,"
there is no place for the decree from the outset,
"does not stand."
And this is "They will thank You... and Your pious ones will bless You,"
that the drawing down from the place where there is thanksgiving in the manner of blessing
(in an automatic way)
is specifically through "Your pious ones,"
for the drawing down that is through "Your pious ones" is from the inner aspect of Atik,
and the drawing down from there is
(not in the manner of action,
but)
in an automatic way.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the difference between the three types of drawing down (Arich, Atik, and the inner aspect of Atik) regarding the refinement of sparks: through Arich it is from above to below, through Atik it also involves the lower entity itself, and through the inner aspect of Atik it reveals that the very existence of every thing is Elokus.
section.t: And now, the distinction between the three aforementioned drawings down
(Arich,
Atik, and the inner aspect of Atik)
also applies to the matter of the refinements.
For the refinement through the revelation of Arich is in a manner from above to below.
That is,
the refinement of the lower is not from the perspective of its existence, but rather,
because through the illumination within it of a revelation of light that is not commensurate with it
[the aspect of Sovev],
it becomes nullified from its existence.
Therefore,
even after the refinement,
that the lower does not oppose is because it was nullified from its existence by the revelation of light,
but not that a change was made in the existence of the lower itself.
And the refinement through the revelation of Atik is also from the perspective of the lower itself.
For since delight
(Atik)
is the inner aspect and life-force of all of Hishtalshelus,
therefore,
the refinement of the lower through this revelation is in a manner that a change is made in the lower itself.
And as explained in the maamar
regarding the refinement through the revelation that shone through Shlomo
[for the revelation that shone through Shlomo is the revelation of Atik],
that the revelation of light drew the sparks to itself,
like a torch that draws sparks to itself.
And since the refinement was in a manner that the sparks
(that are in the lower)
were drawn by themselves to the revelation,
it is therefore understood,
that the refinement then was also from the perspective of the lower.
However, nevertheless,
since even regarding Atik there is the existence of Hishtalshelus,
and from the perspective of the order of Hishtalshelus,
the definition of the lower is that it is lower
(the opposite of upper),
therefore the revelation of the light of the upper that is drawn into it
[and consequently,
also the refinement that is effected through the revelation]
is like an additional thing upon it.
And the refinement through the revelation of the inner aspect of Atik,
since the inner aspect of Atik
(the Ein Sof in Arich Anpin)
is
(in general)
the very Essence of the Ein Sof light,
and regarding the Essence of the Ein Sof light, existence apart from Him does not apply,
and on the contrary,
the true reality of His existence, blessed be He, is the existence of all existences,
therefore,
through the revelation of the inner aspect of Atik,
it is felt in every thing that its very existence is Elokus.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that in the days of Shlomo only those sparks with some aspect of light were refined through the external aspect of Atik, but in the future, through the revelation of the inner aspect of Atik, even darkened sparks will be elevated and physical things themselves will be in ultimate unity with Elokus.
section.t: And this is,
that in the days of Shlomo only those sparks that had some aspect of light were refined, and in the future all sparks will be refined,
for the refinement of sparks through the revelation of the external aspect of Atik
[for the revelation that was in the days of Shlomo was the revelation of the external aspect of Atik]
is not from the perspective of the sparks themselves, but from the fact that the revelation draws the sparks to itself,
and therefore only those sparks that were capable of feeling the revelation of light were refined then.
And the refinement through the revelation of the inner aspect of Atik is that through the revelation of the inner aspect of Atik it is revealed in every thing that its very existence is Elokus,
and therefore in the future, when there will be the revelation of the inner aspect of Atik,
even the sparks that were darkened will be elevated and included in holiness,
and moreover,
even the physical things themselves
(not only the sparks within them)
will be in the ultimate unity with Elokus,
as explained in the discourse "Padeh BeShalom" said on Yud-Tes Kislev.
